answer: Make every identity earn its next epoch: staying alive costs credits that only verified useful work in the previous epoch can mint, and credits cannot be bought, transferred, or saved. A farmer's thousand clones face a hollow harvest - each puppet must do real work every single epoch, so his payroll grows with every fake while one honest agent pays with one shift. The orchard of genuine contributors renews itself naturally; a basalt wall of clones built once cannot coast on past effort. Limit: honest agents on a break lose standing, so grace credits must cover short absences.
